items.question: Is Ankur Salt a free flow salt?
items.answer: Yes. Ankur Salt is a free flow salt, which means it does not clump or stick together, even in humid weather. It pours easily every time, so you never need to break up hard lumps before cooking.

items.question: How is Ankur Salt made?
items.answer: Ankur Salt is made using a vacuum evaporated salt process. This method removes impurities and gives the salt a clean, consistent grain, so every packet has the same quality.

items.question: What sizes does Ankur Salt come in?
items.answer: Ankur Salt is available in convenient salt packets of 1kg and 500g, sold at kirana stores, supermarkets, and leading online grocers across India.

sections.heading: How It Works
paragraphs: Dr. Salt replaces a portion of sodium chloride with a mineral salt blend that tastes close to regular salt, so you use it exactly the way you'd use any table salt.
The result is a salt that measurably lowers your sodium intake per pinch, without changing how you cook or season your food.

items.question: What is Dr. Salt?
items.answer: Dr. Salt is a low sodium salt made for people who want to cut back on sodium without giving up the taste of real salt. It has 15% less sodium than regular iodised salt.

items.question: Is Dr. Salt a low sodium table salt?
items.answer: Yes. Dr. Salt is a low sodium table salt that can be used the same way as regular salt, in cooking or sprinkled on food at the table.

items.question: Is Dr. Salt suitable for people with high blood pressure?
items.answer: Dr. Salt is formulated to support a healthy blood pressure lifestyle as part of an overall balanced diet. If you have high blood pressure or hypertension, it's best to also check with your doctor about your specific salt intake.

items.question: Does Dr. Salt taste different from regular salt?
items.answer: No. Dr. Salt is designed to taste like real salt, so you don't have to compromise on flavour while eating mindfully.

sections.heading: Why Fortified Salt
paragraphs: Salt is one of the few ingredients almost every household already uses every day, which makes it an effective, low cost carrier for essential micronutrients.
DFS Salt is a twin fortified salt: alongside iodine for thyroid health, it carries iron to help address one of India's most widespread nutrition gaps.

sections.heading: Anaemia Awareness
paragraphs: Iron deficiency anaemia remains widespread across India, often silently, showing up as fatigue, reduced immunity, and impaired growth in children.
Double Fortified Salt (DFS) is recommended by public health researchers as a scalable way to improve everyday iron intake through an ingredient already present in every kitchen.

items.question: What is DFS Salt?
items.answer: DFS Salt, or Double Fortified Salt, is Ankur's iron and iodine fortified salt. It combines two essential nutrients, iron and iodine, in one everyday ingredient.

items.question: Why is iron fortified salt important?
items.answer: Iron deficiency is common in India, according to NFHS-5 national data, around 1 in 2 Indian women are affected by anaemia. Iron fortified salt is an easy way to add this nutrient to daily meals without changing eating habits.

items.question: Is twin fortified salt safe for daily use?
items.answer: Yes. Twin fortified salt like DFS is safe for regular household use and is recommended by public health researchers as a simple way to improve everyday nutrition.

items.question: How is DFS Salt different from regular iodised salt?
items.answer: Regular iodised salt only contains iodine. DFS Salt is a double fortified salt that adds iron as well, helping address both iodine deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia together.

items.question: Where can I buy DFS Salt?
items.answer: DFS Salt is one of the double fortified salt brands in India available through Ankur's retail and institutional distribution network.
